title: Tiger Team Maturity Model
context:
## Tiger Team Maturity Model

Etiquetas: Aprendizaje y transmisión de capacidades 18.18%; Autoridad, permisos y delegación 18.18%; Evidencia, procedencia y atribución 18.18%; Transformación y continuidad operativa 45.46%
Ficha: https://dakleyer.github.io/perspective-beyond/sources/tiger-team-maturity-model-n1276/
Documento de origen: https://jubap.net/tiger-team-maturity-model/

relations.title: Legitimidad en ambos lados de una interfaz
Nestlé North America — Where JUBAP Was Named
relations.reading: The Nestlé account describes codification and internal facilitator training, practices that can be compared with repeatability and learning in the maturity model.

relations.title: Case Study: Texas-to-Mexico Oilfield Services Transformation: Knowledge Transfer, Industrialization, and Compliance
relations.reading: The industrialization case describes quality-system and audit-readiness work that can illustrate observable maturity practices without claiming a certified maturity level.

relations.title: Annex 5 — Six Positive Paths and Quality Plans
relations.reading: Maturity claims become more inspectable when each transition is tied to observable execution, exception handling and handover evidence.

relations.title: Attribution Gap Measurement Protocol
relations.reading: The stated Level 3 position is a methodological self-assessment, which should remain separate from certification and independently measured intervention performance.

relations.title: Measuring Human Intelligence Debt
relations.reading: Validated task measurement can strengthen intervention evidence without by itself upgrading a defined Tiger Team model to quantitatively managed maturity.

relations.title: Instituciones de frontera: Cuando emprender es construir un puente entre mundos.
relations.reading: The maturity model could make the institutional claim more inspectable by asking which practices, memory and responsibilities continue beyond an individual intervention.
